en: A vintage postcard with a sepia-toned portrait of an older bearded man in an oval frame on the right side, wearing a suit and tie. The left side is filled with dense handwritten text in German cursive (Kurrent/Sütterlin style). Below the portrait there is a short handwritten note, and at the bottom left is a dated line mentioning Graz, 8 July 1929. The card has a formal, commemorative appearance, like a portrait card or correspondence from an intellectual or public figure.
